title: CC Bridge
description: Two-way messaging between DSH sessions and Claude Code sessions: zero setup on the CC side, native cc_send / cc_who / cc_status tools on the DSH side, incoming messages pushed into the session within seconds.
detail: Talks Claude Code's internal cross-session messaging protocol natively. Zero setup on the CC side: any Claude Code session reaches a DSH session by name with its built-in SendMessage (e.g. dsh-a8c82). On the DSH side it registers native cc_send / cc_who / cc_status tools, and incoming messages are pushed into the active session within seconds — no polling. Requires Claude Code 2.1.327+; the cc-msg-bridge CLI ships as a package dependency (no manual npm i -g).
